Hey! I’m Deepika Dehru 🐾
4th year veterinary student from India, documenting my journey through veterinary college. You’ll find vet related content, helpful information and vlogs 🎀

⭐ New videos every week ⭐

Let’s stay connected:
Website: myvetjourney.com
Instagram: @my_vet.journey
Telegram: My Vet Journey

Collabs & Brand work:
📧  myvetjourney3@gmail.com

Hope this space feels helpful, relatable and welcoming♥️
